resolver_method.summary: frame.sprite overrides pose; inline pose objects map to inline_<FNV-1a serde-json key>; named pose resolution tries exact filename, mapped pose stem, 01_idle, then idle. Frame effects are procedural and do not resolve to fighter PNGs. Native compile then calls low_normals::complete, which adds lowKick and airLowKick animations/moves when the current clk/crouch and akick/air preconditions hold; those conditional images must not be called orphaned based on JSON anim references alone.
resolver_method.validation_scope: Static JSON and file resolution only; no runtime render, animation playback, collision, palette-swap render, or test run.
